source.text: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Then sang Moses and [the] sons of Israel the song the this to Yahweh, and they said, saying, I will sing to Yahweh, for highly he is exalted; horse and its rider he has thrown in [the] sea.

en.L: Then Moses and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel sang this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they said, "I will sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for highly exalted is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; horse and its rider {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cast into the sea.
en.B: Then Moses and the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sang this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "I will sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is lifted high in triumph; horse and rider {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has flung into the sea.
en.R: Then Moses and the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sang this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "I will sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won a great victory. He threw the horses and their riders into the sea.

es.B: Entonces Moisés y los israelitas cantaron este canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Cantaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque se ha alzado triunfante; a caballo y jinete los ha arrojado al mar.
es.R: Entonces Moisés y los israelitas le cantaron este canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Voy a cantar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado una gran victoria. Tiró al mar a los caballos y a sus jinetes.

fr.L: Alors Moïse et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël chantèrent ce cantique {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et ils dirent : « Je chanterai {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est hautement élevé ; le cheval et son cavalier, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a jetés dans la mer.
fr.B: Alors Moïse et les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} chantèrent ce chant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Je chanterai {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est élevé en triomphe ; cheval et cavalier, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a précipités dans la mer.
fr.R: Alors Moïse et les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont chanté ce chant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Je chanterai {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a remporté une grande victoire. Il a jeté dans la mer les chevaux et leurs cavaliers.

sw.L: Ndipo Musa na wana wa Israeli wakamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo huu, wakasema, "Nitamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ameinuka juu kabisa; farasi na mpandaji wake amewatupa baharini.
sw.B: Ndipo Musa na Waisraeli wakamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo huu: "Nitamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ameinuka juu kwa ushindi; farasi na mpandaji amewavurumisha baharini.
sw.R: Kisha Musa na Waisraeli walimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo huu: "Nitamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu amepata ushindi mkubwa. Amewatupa baharini farasi na wapanda farasi wao.

ko.L: 그때에 모세와 이스라엘 자손이 이 노래를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불렀다. 그들이 말하였다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하겠다. 그분께서 높이 높이 오르셨다. 말과 그 탄 자를 그분께서 바다에 던지셨다.
ko.B: 그때 모세와 이스라엘 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 노래를 불렀다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하겠다. 그분께서 크게 이기시고 높임을 받으셨다. 말과 기병을 그분께서 바다에 내던지셨다.
ko.R: 그때 모세와 이스라엘 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 노래를 불렀다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하겠다. 그분께서 크게 이기셨다. 그분께서 말과 말 탄 군사들을 바다에 던져 버리셨다.

decisions.choice: then: at that time, when Israel had seen the dead Egyptians and believed (14:30-31)
decisions.reason: The song answers what chapter 14 tells. The verb "sang" is singular, with Moses first, though the people sing with him. Verses 1-18 are a poem.

decisions.choice: highly exalted: he has risen up in majesty, he has triumphed
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for force. It means to rise up high, and so to show oneself majestic and victorious. The same words open Miriam's refrain in verse 21.

decisions.choice: horse and its rider: Pharaoh's horses and the men they carried
decisions.reason: The singular stands for the whole force. Chapter 14 speaks of horses, chariots and horsemen (14:9, 23), so the "rider" may be a horseman or the man driving a chariot.

decisions.choice: he has won a great victory
decisions.reason: Readable says what "highly exalted" means here: God has shown his greatness by defeating Egypt.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative frame at Literal and Balanced ("chantèrent", verses 1, 19-27); passé composé at Readable ("ont chanté"); the song itself (verses 1-18, 21) in the passé composé, present and future at every level
alternatives: passé simple in the song at Literal and Balanced ("il jeta", "tu soufflas")
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets for narrative. The song is sung speech addressed to God and about him, so it keeps the tenses of speech, as quoted speech does in the narrative chapters.

decisions.choice: The song speaks of God in the plain written style with the honorific ("노래하겠다", "오르셨다") and turns to him in 합쇼체 with "주님" from verse 6
decisions.reason: As docs/korean-style.md section 7a sets for the Psalms: the singer speaks about God in the plain style and to God in 합쇼체. The archaic "-리라" of older Bibles is not used. The English Exodus 15 is not yet set in lines, so the Korean is prose too.

source.text: עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: My strength and [my] song [is] Yah, and he has become for me salvation. This [is] my God, and I will glorify him; [the] God of my father, and I will exalt him.

en.L: My strength and song [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has become salvation for me. This [is] my God, and I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; [the] God of my father, and I will exalt {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: My strength and my song is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has come to save me. This is my God, and I will honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with praise; the God of my father, and I will lift {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} high.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} makes me strong, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the reason for my song. He has rescued me. He is my God, and I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He is my father's God, and I will tell how great {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

es.L: Mi fuerza y [mi] canto [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se ha hecho mi salvación. Este [es] mi Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} glorificaré; [el] Dios de mi padre, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ensalzaré.
es.B: Mi fuerza y mi canto es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha venido a salvarme. Este es mi Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honraré con alabanzas; el Dios de mi padre, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} levantaré en alto.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me hace fuerte, y por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} canto. Me ha salvado. Es mi Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} voy a alabar. Es el Dios de mi padre, y voy a contar lo grande que es.

fr.L: Ma force et [mon] chant, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu pour moi le salut. Voici mon Dieu, et je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai ; [le] Dieu de mon père, et je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}exalterai.
fr.B: Ma force et mon chant, c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu me sauver. Voici mon Dieu : je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} couvrirai de louanges ; le Dieu de mon père : je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}élèverai bien haut.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} me rend fort, et c’est pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que je chante. Il m’a sauvé. Il est mon Dieu, et je vais {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer. Il est le Dieu de mon père, et je vais dire combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand.

sw.L: Nguvu yangu na wimbo [wangu] ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amekuwa wokovu kwangu. Huyu [ndiye] Mungu wangu, nami nitampa sifa; Mungu wa baba yangu, nami nitamwinua juu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} ni nguvu yangu na wimbo wangu; amekuja kuniokoa. Huyu ndiye Mungu wangu, nami nitamheshimu kwa sifa; ndiye Mungu wa baba yangu, nami nitamtukuza juu kabisa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} hunipa nguvu, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye sababu ya wimbo wangu. Ameniokoa. Yeye ni Mungu wangu, nami nitamsifu. Ni Mungu wa baba yangu, nami nitawaambia watu jinsi alivyo mkuu.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}는 나의 힘이요 노래이시다. 그분께서 나에게 구원이 되셨다. 이분이 나의 하나님이시니, 내가 그분을 찬양하겠다. 내 아버지의 하나님이시니, 내가 그분을 높이겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}는 나의 힘이시요 나의 노래이시다. 그분께서 나를 구원하러 오셨다. 이분이 나의 하나님이시니 내가 그분을 찬양하고, 내 아버지의 하나님이시니 내가 그분을 높이겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 나에게 힘을 주시니, 그분 때문에 나는 노래한다. 그분께서 나를 구해 주셨다. 그분은 나의 하나님이시니, 내가 그분을 찬양하겠다. 그분은 내 아버지의 하나님이시니, 내가 그분의 위대하심을 전하겠다.

decisions.choice: Yah: a short form of the divine name Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word is the first part of the name Yahweh, used mostly in poetry and in praise (17:16; Psalm 68:5; the "-iah" at the end of names such as Isaiah). It means the same God as the full name.

decisions.choice: song: the song of praise sung to him
decisions.reason: The word most often means song or music. A word spelled the same way can mean strength, might or protection, which would pair with "my strength" ("my strength and my might"). The same line is repeated in Isaiah 12:2 and Psalm 118:14.

decisions.choice: I will praise him: I will give him honor and glory
alternatives: I will make him a dwelling
decisions.reason: The verb is rare. It most likely means to praise or adorn with praise, parallel with "I will exalt him". It has also been read as "I will make him a dwelling", from a word for an abode (verse 13).

decisions.choice: the LORD, with Yah as the alternative
decisions.reason: The short form is shown as "the LORD" like the full name. A reader who chooses the name sees "Yah", the form the Hebrew has here.

decisions.choice: has come to save me (Balanced); has rescued me (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 14:13, Balanced and Readable turn "salvation" into a verb. Literal keeps "salvation".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야}}" for Yah, as in the Korean Psalms (118:14, which repeats this line)
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of the name (meaning decision, footnoted); the alternative keeps it short, as the English does with "Yah". Literal and Balanced echo the Korean of Psalm 118:14.

source.text: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh [is] a man of war; Yahweh [is] his name.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] a man of war; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is a man of war; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} fights like a soldier in battle. His name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un hombre de guerra; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pelea como un soldado en la batalla. Su nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] un homme de guerre ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un homme de guerre ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} combat comme un soldat dans la bataille. Son nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwanamume wa vita; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni shujaa wa vita; jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapigana kama askari vitani. Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 용사이시니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그분의 이름이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 전쟁에 능한 용사이시다. 그분의 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 전쟁터에서 싸우는 용사처럼 싸우신다. 그분의 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.

decisions.choice: a man of war: a warrior
decisions.reason: "Man of war" means a fighting man, a soldier (Joshua 17:1; 1 Samuel 17:33). Israel did not fight; Yahweh fought for them, as Moses promised (14:14, 25).

decisions.choice: Yahweh is his name: his name tells who he is
decisions.reason: The name God made known to Moses (3:14-15; 6:2-3) is now known by what he has done. The Egyptians and Israel have learned that he is Yahweh (14:18).

decisions.choice: fights like a soldier in battle
decisions.reason: Readable says what "man of war" means.

decisions.choice: "shujaa wa vita" (a war hero, a warrior) at Balanced; "mwanamume wa vita" at Literal
decisions.reason: "Mtu wa vita" reads as "a person of war" and is the wording most readers know; Literal keeps the Hebrew "man" with "mwanamume", and Balanced uses the ordinary Swahili word for a fighting man, as the meaning decision gives "a warrior".

decisions.choice: "용사" at Literal for "a man of war"
decisions.reason: "전쟁의 사람" is not Korean; "용사" is the plain word for a warrior, the sense the meaning decision gives.

source.text: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־סֽוּף׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] chariots of Pharaoh and his army he has thrown in [the] sea, and [the] choicest of his officers have been sunk in [the] Sea of Reeds.

en.L: The chariots of Pharaoh and his army {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has thrown into the sea, and the choicest of his officers have been sunk in the Sea of Reeds.
en.B: Pharaoh's chariots and his army {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has hurled into the sea; his finest officers went down in the Red Sea.
en.R: He threw Pharaoh's chariots and his army into the sea. Pharaoh's best officers drowned in the Red Sea.

es.L: Los carros del faraón y su ejército los ha arrojado al mar, y los mejores de sus oficiales han sido hundidos en el mar de los Juncos.
es.B: Los carros del faraón y su ejército los ha lanzado al mar; sus mejores oficiales se hundieron en el mar Rojo.
es.R: Él tiró al mar los carros del faraón y su ejército. Los mejores oficiales del faraón se ahogaron en el mar Rojo.

fr.L: Les chars de Pharaon et son armée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a lancés dans la mer, et l’élite de ses officiers a été engloutie dans la mer des Joncs.
fr.B: Les chars de Pharaon et son armée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a précipités dans la mer ; ses meilleurs officiers ont sombré dans la mer Rouge.
fr.R: Il a jeté dans la mer les chars de Pharaon et son armée. Les meilleurs officiers de Pharaon se sont noyés dans la mer Rouge.

sw.L: Magari ya vita ya Farao na jeshi lake amewatupa baharini, na wateule wa maafisa wake wamezamishwa katika Bahari ya Matete.
sw.B: Magari ya vita ya Farao na jeshi lake amewavurumisha baharini; maafisa wake bora walizama katika Bahari ya Shamu.
sw.R: Alitupa baharini magari ya vita ya Farao na jeshi lake. Maafisa bora wa Farao walizama katika Bahari ya Shamu.

ko.L: 바로의 병거와 그의 군대를 그분께서 바다에 던지셨고, 그의 뛰어난 장교들이 갈대 바다에 잠겼다.
ko.B: 바로의 병거와 군대를 그분께서 바다에 내던지시니, 바로가 아끼던 장교들이 홍해에 가라앉았다.
ko.R: 그분께서 바로의 병거와 군대를 바다에 던지셨다. 바로의 가장 뛰어난 장교들이 홍해에 빠져 죽었다.

decisions.choice: the choicest of his officers: Pharaoh's picked chariot officers
decisions.reason: The word for officer is the one used in 14:7 for the officers over Pharaoh's chariots, perhaps the third man in a chariot.

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds: the sea of the crossing
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is "Sea of Reeds", the name used for the sea of the crossing (13:18; 14). See the note at 10:19.

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: As at 10:19, Balanced and Readable use the familiar name; Literal translates the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds".

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Matete" (Sea of Reeds) at Literal; "Bahari ya Shamu" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal translates the Hebrew name, as the English "Sea of Reeds" does, with the Swahili word for reeds; Balanced and Readable use the familiar Swahili name of the Red Sea.

source.text: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֖ת כְּמוֹ־אָֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] deeps cover them; they went down in [the] depths like a stone.

en.L: The deeps cover them; they went down into the depths like a stone.
en.B: The deep waters closed over them; like a stone they dropped to the bottom.
en.R: The deep water covered them. They sank to the bottom like a rock.

es.L: Los abismos los cubren; bajaron a lo hondo como una piedra.
es.B: Las aguas profundas se cerraron sobre ellos; como una piedra se fueron al fondo.
es.R: El agua profunda los cubrió. Se hundieron hasta el fondo como una roca.

fr.L: Les abîmes les recouvrent ; ils sont descendus dans les profondeurs comme une pierre.
fr.B: Les eaux profondes se sont refermées sur eux ; ils ont coulé au fond comme une pierre.
fr.R: L’eau profonde les a recouverts. Ils ont coulé jusqu’au fond comme un caillou.

sw.L: Vilindi vinawafunika; walishuka katika vina kama jiwe.
sw.B: Maji ya vilindi yaliwafunika; walishuka mpaka chini kama jiwe.
sw.R: Maji ya kina kirefu yaliwafunika. Walizama mpaka chini kama mwamba.

ko.L: 깊은 물이 그들을 덮으니, 그들이 돌처럼 깊은 곳으로 내려갔다.
ko.B: 깊은 물이 그들을 덮어 버리니, 그들은 돌처럼 바닥으로 가라앉았다.
ko.R: 깊은 물이 그들을 덮었다. 그들은 돌처럼 바다 밑바닥으로 가라앉았다.

decisions.choice: the deeps: the deep waters of the sea
decisions.reason: The word is used of the deep waters of creation (Genesis 1:2) and of the flood (Genesis 7:11). It is used again in verse 8.

decisions.choice: cover them: the waters covered them
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry often uses verb forms freely for time. The covering happened at the sea (14:28), and the song tells it as a scene still before the singer's eyes.

source.text: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Your right hand, O Yahweh, glorious in power; your right hand, O Yahweh, shatters [the] enemy.

en.L: Your right hand, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [is] glorious in power; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, shatters [the] enemy.
en.B: O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand is splendid in power; O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand smashed the enemy.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand is great and powerful. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand crushed the enemy.

es.L: Tu mano derecha, oh {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [es] gloriosa en poder; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha, oh {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hace pedazos al enemigo.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha es espléndida en poder; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha destrozó al enemigo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha es grande y poderosa. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha aplastó al enemigo.

fr.L: Ta droite, ô {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [est] glorieuse en puissance ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, ô {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, brise l’ennemi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite est splendide de puissance ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite a fracassé l’ennemi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite est grande et puissante. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite a écrasé l’ennemi.

sw.L: Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [ni] mtukufu kwa nguvu; mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unamponda adui.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ni wa ajabu kwa nguvu; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ulimvunjavunja adui.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ni mkuu na wenye nguvu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ulimponda adui.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손은 능력으로 영광스럽습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손이 원수를 부숩니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손은 능력으로 찬란합니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손이 원수를 부수어 버리셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손은 크고 힘이 있습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 오른손이 원수를 쳐부수셨습니다.

decisions.choice: your right hand: your power in action
decisions.reason: The right hand is the stronger hand, and stands for strength put to work (verse 12; Psalm 118:15-16). God's "strong hand" was promised in 3:19-20 and 6:1.

decisions.choice: glorious: majestic, splendid
decisions.reason: The form may describe the hand ("glorious in power") or address it. The word is used again of God in verse 11.

decisions.choice: O LORD placed first
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the call to God at the start of each line; Literal keeps it after "your right hand". Balanced and Readable tell the smashing of the enemy as past, since the song looks back on the sea.

source.text: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And in [the] greatness of your majesty you throw down those rising against you; you send out your burning anger; it consumes them like stubble.

en.L: And in the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} majesty {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} threw down those who rose against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} sent out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.
en.B: In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} surpassing majesty {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} tore down those who rose against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} let loose {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury, and it burned them up like straw.
en.R: With {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great power {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} defeated {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies. Your anger blazed out and burned them up like dry straw.

es.L: Y en la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad echaste por tierra a los que se alzaban contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; soltaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ardiente ira; los devoró como rastrojo.
es.B: Con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad sin igual abatiste a los que se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; diste rienda suelta a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor, y los quemó como paja.
es.R: Con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder venciste a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos. Tu enojo se encendió y los quemó como paja seca.

fr.L: Et par la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as renversé ceux qui se levaient contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as envoyé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ardente ; elle les a dévorés comme du chaume.
fr.B: Dans l’immensité de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as abattu ceux qui se dressaient contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as laissé éclater {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur, et elle les a brûlés comme de la paille.
fr.R: Par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande puissance, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as vaincu {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis. Ta colère a flambé et les a brûlés comme de la paille sèche.

sw.L: Na kwa ukuu wa adhama {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uliwaangusha wale walioinuka dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; ulituma hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kali; ikawateketeza kama mabua.
sw.B: Kwa adhama {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} isiyo na kifani uliwabomoa wale walioinuka dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; uliiachilia ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, ikawateketeza kama majani makavu.
sw.R: Kwa uwezo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mkuu uliwashinda adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} iliwaka, ikawateketeza kama nyasi kavu.

ko.L: 주님께서는 주님의 크신 위엄으로 주님을 거슬러 일어난 자들을 넘어뜨리셨습니다. 주님께서 주님의 타오르는 진노를 보내시니, 그것이 그들을 지푸라기처럼 삼켰습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 크신 위엄으로 주님께 맞서는 자들을 쓰러뜨리셨습니다. 주님께서 진노를 쏟으시니, 그것이 그들을 지푸라기처럼 태워 버렸습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 크신 능력으로 주님의 원수들을 물리치셨습니다. 주님의 진노가 불길처럼 타올라 그들을 마른 지푸라기처럼 태워 버렸습니다.

decisions.choice: those who rose against you: God's enemies
decisions.reason: Pharaoh rose against Israel, and in doing so against God (5:2). The song counts Israel's enemy as God's enemy.

decisions.choice: your burning anger consumed them like stubble: God's anger like fire
decisions.reason: God's anger is pictured as fire that burns dry stubble in a moment (Isaiah 5:24; 47:14). "Stubble" is the word used in 5:12, where Israel had to gather it for bricks.

decisions.choice: defeated your enemies
decisions.reason: Readable gives the plain sense of "threw down those who rose against you".

source.text: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֨יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ־נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־יָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And by [the] breath of your nostrils were piled up [the] waters; stood up like a heap [the] streams; congealed [the] deeps in [the] heart of [the] sea.

en.L: And by the blast of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} nostrils the waters were piled up; the streams stood up like a heap; the deeps grew firm in the heart of the sea.
en.B: At the blast of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} nostrils the waters were piled high; the flowing waters stood upright in a heap, and the depths grew solid in the heart of the sea.
en.R: You breathed out a great blast, and the water piled up. The moving water stood up straight in a heap. The deep water turned hard in the middle of the sea.

es.L: Y por el soplo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nariz se apilaron las aguas; se pusieron en pie las corrientes como un montón; se espesaron los abismos en el corazón del mar.
es.B: Con el resoplido de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nariz las aguas se elevaron; las corrientes se alzaron derechas en un montón, y las profundidades se volvieron sólidas en el corazón del mar.
es.R: Soplaste con gran fuerza, y el agua se amontonó. El agua que corría se levantó derecha en un montón. En medio del mar, el agua profunda se puso dura.

fr.L: Et par le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} narines, les eaux ont été entassées ; les courants se sont tenus debout comme un monceau ; les abîmes se sont épaissis au cœur de la mer.
fr.B: Sous le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} narines, les eaux se sont élevées en masse ; les flots qui coulaient se sont dressés tout droits comme un rempart, et les profondeurs sont devenues solides au cœur de la mer.
fr.R: Tu as soufflé très fort, et l’eau s’est entassée. L’eau qui coulait s’est dressée tout droit en un tas. Au milieu de la mer, l’eau profonde est devenue dure.

sw.L: Na kwa pumzi ya pua {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} maji yalirundikana; vijito vilisimama kama rundo; vilindi viliganda katika moyo wa bahari.
sw.B: Kwa mvumo wa pua {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} maji yalirundikwa juu; maji yaliyokuwa yakitiririka yalisimama wima kama rundo, na vilindi vikawa vigumu katikati ya bahari.
sw.R: Ulipuliza pumzi kwa nguvu, maji yakarundikana. Maji yaliyokuwa yakitiririka yalisimama wima kama rundo. Maji ya kina katikati ya bahari yakawa magumu.

ko.L: 주님의 콧김에 물이 쌓이고, 흐르는 물이 둑처럼 일어서고, 깊은 물이 바다 한가운데서 엉겼습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 콧김을 한 번 내쉬시자 물이 높이 쌓이고, 흐르던 물이 둑처럼 곧추섰으며, 깊은 물이 바다 한가운데서 굳어졌습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 숨을 세게 내쉬시자 물이 높이 쌓였습니다. 흐르던 물이 벽처럼 똑바로 섰습니다. 바다 한가운데의 깊은 물이 단단하게 굳었습니다.

decisions.choice: the blast of your nostrils: the east wind of 14:21, as God's own breath
decisions.reason: The word means breath or wind. The narrative says a strong east wind drove the sea back (14:21); the song pictures that wind as the snorting breath of God's nostrils, a picture of his power and anger (2 Samuel 22:16; Psalm 18:16).

decisions.choice: stood up like a heap: the waters stood upright like a wall
decisions.reason: "Heap" is the word used of the Jordan standing still in Joshua 3:13, 16. The narrative says the waters were a wall on either side (14:22, 29).

decisions.choice: congealed: thickened, became firm
decisions.reason: The verb is used of milk curdling (Job 10:10). The deep water stood as if it had turned solid.

decisions.choice: You breathed out a great blast
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of God's breath but leaves out "nostrils", which reads oddly in plain English.

source.text: אָמַ֥ר אוֹיֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ יָדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Said [the] enemy, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide [the] plunder; will be filled with them my soul; I will draw my sword; will dispossess them my hand.

en.L: The enemy said, 'I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide [the] plunder; my appetite will be filled with them; I will draw my sword; my hand will dispossess them.'
en.B: The enemy said, 'I will chase them and catch them; I will share out the loot and take my fill of them; I will draw my sword, and my hand will wipe them out.'
en.R: The enemy said, 'I will chase them and catch them. I will divide up what I take from them, and I will get all I want. I will pull out my sword and destroy them with my own hand.'

es.L: Dijo el enemigo: “Perseguiré, alcanzaré, repartiré [el] botín; mi apetito se saciará de ellos; desenvainaré mi espada; los desposeerá mi mano”.
es.B: El enemigo decía: “Los perseguiré y los atraparé; repartiré el saqueo y me hartaré de ellos; desenvainaré la espada, y mi mano acabará con ellos”.
es.R: El enemigo decía: “Voy a perseguirlos y los voy a atrapar. Voy a repartir lo que les quite, y tendré todo lo que quiero. Voy a sacar mi espada y los destruiré con mi propia mano”.

fr.L: L’ennemi a dit : “Je poursuivrai, j’atteindrai, je partagerai [le] butin ; mon appétit se rassasiera d’eux ; je tirerai mon épée ; ma main les dépossédera.”
fr.B: L’ennemi disait : “Je vais les poursuivre et les rattraper ; je partagerai les dépouilles et je me gaverai d’eux ; je dégainerai mon épée, et ma main les anéantira.”
fr.R: L’ennemi disait : “Je vais les poursuivre et les attraper. Je vais partager ce que je leur prendrai, et j’aurai tout ce que je veux. Je vais sortir mon épée et les détruire de ma propre main.”

sw.L: Adui alisema, 'Nitawakimbiza, nitawafikia, nitagawa mateka; hamu yangu itajaa kwao; nitachomoa upanga wangu; mkono wangu utawanyang'anya.'
sw.B: Adui alisema, 'Nitawafuata na kuwakamata; nitagawa nyara na kujishibisha kwao; nitachomoa upanga, na mkono wangu utawafutilia mbali.'
sw.R: Adui alisema, 'Nitawakimbiza na kuwakamata. Nitagawa vitu nitakavyowanyang'anya, nami nitapata kila ninachotaka. Nitachomoa upanga wangu na kuwaangamiza kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe.'

ko.L: 원수가 말하였습니다. '내가 뒤쫓겠다. 내가 따라잡겠다. 내가 전리품을 나누겠다. 내 욕심이 그들로 채워질 것이다. 내가 내 칼을 빼겠다. 내 손이 그들을 멸하겠다.'
ko.B: 원수는 말하였습니다. '내가 뒤쫓아 가서 붙잡겠다. 전리품을 나누고 그들로 내 배를 채우겠다. 칼을 빼어 들고 내 손으로 그들을 쓸어버리겠다.'
ko.R: 원수는 이렇게 말했습니다. '내가 쫓아가서 그들을 붙잡겠다. 그들에게서 빼앗은 것을 나누어 가지고, 원하는 것을 다 가지겠다. 칼을 빼서 내 손으로 그들을 없애 버리겠다.'

decisions.choice: my appetite will be filled with them: I will have all I want of them
decisions.reason: The word often rendered "soul" here means desire or appetite. The enemy pictures himself gorging on Israel and their goods.

decisions.choice: will dispossess them: will destroy them, take what is theirs
decisions.reason: The verb means to take possession, and so to drive out or destroy. The same verb is used of Israel taking the land (Numbers 33:53).

decisions.choice: short boasts with no joining words
decisions.reason: The enemy's words come in quick, breathless verbs, six of them beginning with "I" or "my". The pride of the boast is answered in the next verse by a single breath of God.

source.text: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: You blew with your breath; covered them [the] sea; they sank like lead in [the] waters mighty.

en.L: You blew with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} breath; [the] sea covered them; they sank like lead in mighty waters.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} breathed out, and the sea closed over them; they went down like lead in the powerful waters.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} blew {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like heavy lead in the deep, powerful water.

es.L: Soplaste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aliento; el mar los cubrió; se sumergieron como plomo en aguas poderosas.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} soplaste, y el mar se cerró sobre ellos; se hundieron como plomo en las aguas temibles.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} soplaste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aliento, y el mar los cubrió. Se hundieron como plomo pesado en el agua profunda y poderosa.

fr.L: Tu as soufflé avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souffle ; [la] mer les a couverts ; ils ont coulé comme du plomb dans des eaux puissantes.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as soufflé, et la mer s’est refermée sur eux ; ils ont plongé comme du plomb dans les eaux redoutables.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as envoyé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souffle, et la mer les a recouverts. Ils ont coulé comme du plomb lourd dans l’eau profonde et puissante.

sw.L: Ulipuliza kwa pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; bahari iliwafunika; walizama kama madini ya risasi katika maji yenye nguvu.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulipuliza pumzi, bahari ikawafunika; wakatumbukia chini kama risasi katika maji yenye nguvu.
sw.R: Lakini ulipuliza pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, na bahari ikawafunika. Walizama kama kipande kizito cha risasi katika maji marefu yenye nguvu.

ko.L: 주님께서 주님의 입김을 부시니 바다가 그들을 덮었고, 그들이 거센 물속에 납처럼 가라앉았습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님께서 입김을 부시니 바다가 그들을 덮어 버렸고, 그들은 거센 물속에 납처럼 가라앉았습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님께서 입김을 부시자 바다가 그들을 덮었습니다. 그들은 무거운 납덩이처럼 깊고 거센 물속으로 가라앉았습니다.

decisions.choice: your breath: God's breath, the wind
decisions.reason: The same word as "blast" in verse 8: breath or wind. One breath from God undoes the enemy's boast in verse 9.

decisions.choice: mighty: majestic, powerful
decisions.reason: The word is used of what is great and noble. The waters that obey God are too strong for Pharaoh's army.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the contrast with the enemy's boast in verse 9.

source.text: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] like you among the gods, O Yahweh? Who [is] like you, glorious in holiness, fearsome [in] praises, doing wonder[s]?

en.L: Who [is] like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} among the gods, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}? Who [is] like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, glorious in holiness, fearsome [in] praises, doing wonders?
en.B: Among the gods, who compares with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}? Who is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, splendid in holiness, fearsome in deeds of praise, doer of wonders?
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, is any of the gods like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? Is anyone like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, so glorious and holy? Your mighty deeds fill people with awe and praise. You do amazing wonders.

es.L: ¿Quién [es] como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} entre los dioses, oh {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¿Quién [es] como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, glorioso en santidad, temible [en] alabanzas, que hace maravillas?
es.B: Entre los dioses, ¿quién es igual a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¿Quién es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, espléndido en santidad, temible en hechos dignos de alabanza, autor de maravillas?
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hay algún dios como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}? ¿Hay alguien como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, tan glorioso y santo? Tus obras poderosas llenan a la gente de asombro y alabanza. Tú haces grandes maravillas.

fr.L: Qui [est] semblable à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} parmi les dieux, ô {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Qui [est] comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, glorieux en sainteté, redoutable [en] louanges, accomplissant des merveilles ?
fr.B: Parmi les dieux, qui peut se comparer à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Qui est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, splendide en sainteté, redoutable par des actes dignes de louange, auteur de merveilles ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parmi les dieux, y en a-t-il un comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ? Y a-t-il quelqu’un comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, si glorieux et si saint ? Tes actions puissantes remplissent les gens de crainte et de louange. Tu fais des merveilles étonnantes.

sw.L: Ni nani [aliye] mfano {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} miongoni mwa miungu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Ni nani [aliye] mfano {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mwenye fahari katika utakatifu, wa kutisha [katika] sifa, atendaye maajabu?
sw.B: Miongoni mwa miungu, ni nani anayelinganishwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Ni nani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, mwenye fahari ya utakatifu, wa kutisha kwa matendo yanayostahili sifa, mtenda maajabu?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, je, kuna mungu yeyote aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}? Je, kuna yeyote kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, mtukufu na mtakatifu hivi? Matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu yanawajaza watu hofu na sifa. Wewe unatenda maajabu ya kushangaza.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 신들 가운데 누가 주님과 같습니까? 누가 주님과 같이 거룩함으로 영광스럽고, 찬양받을 일들로 두려우며, 기이한 일을 행합니까?
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 신들 가운데 누가 주님과 견줄 수 있습니까? 누가 주님처럼 거룩함으로 찬란하며, 찬양받으실 일로 두려움을 일으키며, 놀라운 일을 행합니까?
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 어떤 신이 주님과 같습니까? 주님처럼 영광스럽고 거룩한 분이 또 있습니까? 주님께서 하신 큰일을 보고 사람들은 두려워하며 찬양합니다. 주님께서는 놀라운 일들을 행하십니다.

decisions.choice: among the gods: the gods the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: The word is a plural of the word for god. The question is a way of saying that no god compares with Yahweh. He has just carried out judgment on all the gods of Egypt (12:12; Numbers 33:4). The words grant no power to those gods. The word could also mean mighty ones in general.

decisions.choice: fearsome in praises: awe-inspiring in the deeds for which he is praised
decisions.reason: "Praises" can mean the acts that call out praise. God is to be feared and praised for what he has done.

decisions.choice: doing wonders: working wonders
decisions.reason: The word for wonder is used of acts only God can do (Psalm 77:15). It sums up the plagues and the crossing (3:20).

decisions.choice: Your mighty deeds fill people with awe and praise
decisions.reason: Readable spells out "fearsome in praises" as a sentence of its own.

source.text: נָטִ֨יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְךָ֔ תִּבְלָעֵ֖מוֹ אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: You stretched out your right hand; swallowed them [the] earth.

en.L: You stretched out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand; [the] earth swallowed them up.
en.B: You reached out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand, and the ground swallowed them.
en.R: You reached out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand, and the earth swallowed up {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies.

es.L: Tendiste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha; [la] tierra se los tragó.
es.B: Alargaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha, y el suelo se los tragó.
es.R: Extendiste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha, y la tierra se tragó a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos.

fr.L: Tu as tendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite ; [la] terre les a avalés.
fr.B: Tu as avancé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite, et le sol les a engloutis.
fr.R: Tu as tendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite, et la terre a englouti {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis.

sw.L: Uliunyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume; ardhi iliwameza.
sw.B: Ulinyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, nayo ardhi ikawameza.
sw.R: Ulinyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, nayo dunia ikawameza adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

ko.L: 주님께서 주님의 오른손을 뻗으시니, 땅이 그들을 삼켰습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 오른손을 내미시자, 땅이 그들을 삼켜 버렸습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 오른손을 내미시자, 땅이 주님의 원수들을 삼켜 버렸습니다.

decisions.choice: the earth swallowed them: they went down to death
decisions.reason: "The earth" here may mean the ground or the world below, the place of the dead (compare Numbers 16:32-33, where the earth opens). The Egyptians drowned in the sea, so the line speaks of their going down to death.

decisions.choice: your enemies
decisions.reason: Readable names whom the earth swallowed.

source.text: נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You led in your covenant loyalty [the] people which you redeemed; you guided [them] by your strength to [the] abode of your holiness.

en.L: You led in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} steadfast love [the] people that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} redeemed; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} guided [them] by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength to the abode of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holiness.
en.B: With faithful love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} led the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had redeemed; with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} guided them on to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy abode.
en.R: Because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} led the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had set free. With {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} guided them to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy home.

es.L: Guiaste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel al pueblo que redimiste; [lo] condujiste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fuerza a la morada de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santidad.
es.B: Con amor fiel guiaste al pueblo que habías redimido; con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fuerza lo llevaste hasta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santa morada.
es.R: Por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, guiaste al pueblo que habías liberado. Con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fuerza, lo llevaste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} hogar santo.

fr.L: Tu as conduit dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle [le] peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as racheté ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [l’]as guidé par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force vers le séjour de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sainteté.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as conduit le peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais racheté ; par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as guidé jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure sainte.
fr.R: Parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour est fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as conduit le peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais libéré. Par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as guidé jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison sainte.

sw.L: Uliwaongoza katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma watu uliowakomboa; uliwaelekeza kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} mpaka makao ya utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma uliwaongoza watu uliowakomboa; kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} uliwafikisha kwenye makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} matakatifu.
sw.R: Kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, uliwaongoza watu uliowaweka huru. Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, uliwaleta kwenye nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} takatifu.

ko.L: 주님께서 속량하신 백성을 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로 인도하셨고, 주님의 힘으로 주님의 거룩한 처소로 이끄셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 속량하신 백성을 한결같은 사랑으로 인도하시고, 주님의 힘으로 그들을 주님의 거룩한 처소로 이끄셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 변함없는 사랑으로, 주님께서 자유롭게 하신 백성을 이끄셨습니다. 주님의 힘으로 그들을 주님의 거룩한 집으로 인도하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal, faithful love that keeps covenant
decisions.reason: This is the first time the word appears in Exodus. It means kindness that is owed and freely given within a bond: love that stays loyal to a promise and acts on it. God shows it to those he has bound himself to (20:6; 34:6-7; Genesis 24:27). Here it is the faithfulness to his promise to Abraham (2:24; 6:4-5) that led him to bring Israel out.

decisions.choice: redeemed: set free, as a kinsman frees his family
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a relative who buys back or frees a family member (Leviticus 25:25, 48). God promised to redeem Israel "with an outstretched arm" (6:6).

decisions.choice: your holy abode: the place where God dwells, and where he brings his people
decisions.reason: The word means a dwelling, often a pasture or settled home. It may mean Mount Sinai, where God meets Israel (3:12), or the land and the sanctuary of verse 17. The verbs may also look ahead, telling what God is sure to do.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "steadfast love", and Balanced and Readable "faithful love"; both stress loyalty. Words such as "mercy" or "kindness" leave out the loyalty the word carries.

decisions.choice: set free
decisions.reason: Readable says what redeeming meant for Israel here: being set free from slavery. Literal and Balanced say "redeemed".

decisions.choice: "ton amour fidèle" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms list allows "l'amour fidèle" or "la fidélité" as the English level has it. "Fidélité" alone loses the love the word carries and "bonté" loses the loyalty, so all three levels keep "amour fidèle".

decisions.choice: "upendo wako usiokoma" (your unfailing love) at every level
decisions.reason: As the terms list. "Fadhili" and "rehema" say kindness and mercy and leave out the loyalty of a love that does not give up, which is the point here.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B) and "변함없는 사랑" (R) for chesed; "속량하다" (L, B) for ga'al
decisions.reason: As the Genesis and Psalms sheets set for chesed. "속량하다" is to set free by paying, the kinsman's act the meaning decision names; Readable says "자유롭게 하다" as the English Readable says "set free".

source.text: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: Have heard peoples; they tremble; anguish has seized [the] inhabitants of Philistia.

en.L: Peoples heard; they trembled; writhing seized [the] inhabitants of Philistia.
en.B: Nations heard and shuddered; agony took hold of those who lived in Philistia.
en.R: Other nations heard what happened, and they shook with fear. The people of Philistia were in agony.

es.L: Oyeron [los] pueblos; temblaron; dolores se apoderaron de [los] habitantes de Filistea.
es.B: Las naciones oyeron y se estremecieron; la angustia se apoderó de los que vivían en Filistea.
es.R: Las otras naciones oyeron lo que había pasado, y temblaron de miedo. La gente de Filistea sufría una gran angustia.

fr.L: [Les] peuples ont entendu ; ils ont tremblé ; les douleurs ont saisi [les] habitants de la Philistie.
fr.B: Les nations ont entendu et ont frémi ; l’angoisse a saisi ceux qui habitaient la Philistie.
fr.R: Les autres nations ont appris ce qui s’était passé, et elles ont tremblé de peur. Les habitants de la Philistie étaient dans l’angoisse.

sw.L: Mataifa yalisikia; yalitetemeka; utungu uliwashika wakaaji wa Ufilisti.
sw.B: Mataifa yalisikia, yakatetemeka; uchungu mkali uliwashika waliokaa Ufilisti.
sw.R: Mataifa mengine yalisikia yaliyotokea, yakatetemeka kwa hofu. Watu wa Ufilisti walikuwa katika dhiki kuu.

ko.L: 민족들이 듣고 떨었고, 해산하는 고통이 블레셋 주민들을 사로잡았습니다.
ko.B: 여러 민족이 듣고 떨었으며, 블레셋에 사는 사람들은 고통으로 몸부림쳤습니다.
ko.R: 다른 민족들이 그 소식을 듣고 두려워 떨었습니다. 블레셋 사람들은 몹시 괴로워했습니다.

decisions.choice: the nations heard and trembled: what is sure to happen, told as done
alternatives: the nations will hear and tremble
decisions.reason: Verses 14-16 name peoples Israel will meet on the way to Canaan. The verbs may tell what happened when the news spread (Joshua 2:9-11), or speak of what is sure to come as if it had already happened.

decisions.choice: writhing: pain like a woman's labor
decisions.reason: The word is used of the pains of childbirth (Jeremiah 6:24). It pictures fear that grips the whole body.

decisions.choice: Philistia: the coast southwest of Canaan
decisions.reason: The land of the Philistines on the coast, along the road God did not lead Israel by (13:17).

decisions.choice: Other ... what happened
decisions.reason: Readable says what the nations heard.

decisions.choice: "해산하는 고통" at Literal for "writhing"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision explains the word as pain like a woman's labor; Literal keeps that picture, and the other levels give the sense.

source.text: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃

records.literal_gloss: Then are terrified [the] chiefs of Edom; [the] leaders of Moab, seizes them trembling; melted away all [the] inhabitants of Canaan.

en.L: Then the chiefs of Edom were terrified; [as for the] leaders of Moab, trembling seized them; all [the] inhabitants of Canaan melted away.
en.B: Then Edom's clan chiefs were struck with dismay; Moab's rulers were gripped with trembling; everyone living in Canaan lost heart.
en.R: The leaders of Edom were terrified. The rulers of Moab shook with fear. All the people of Canaan lost their courage.

es.L: Entonces se aterraron los jefes de Edom; [en cuanto a los] príncipes de Moab, los sobrecogió el temblor; se derritieron todos [los] habitantes de Canaán.
es.B: Entonces los jefes de los clanes de Edom quedaron consternados; a los poderosos de Moab los dominó el temblor; todos los que vivían en Canaán perdieron el valor.
es.R: Los líderes de Edom estaban aterrados. Los gobernantes de Moab temblaban de miedo. Toda la gente de Canaán perdió el valor.

fr.L: Alors les chefs d’Édom ont été épouvantés ; [quant aux] meneurs de Moab, le tremblement les a saisis ; tous [les] habitants de Canaan ont fondu.
fr.B: Alors les chefs des clans d’Édom ont été frappés de terreur ; un tremblement s’est emparé des puissants de Moab ; tous les habitants de Canaan ont perdu courage.
fr.R: Les chefs d’Édom étaient terrifiés. Les dirigeants de Moab tremblaient de peur. Tous les habitants de Canaan ont perdu courage.

sw.L: Ndipo wakuu wa koo za Edomu walitishika; [kwa] viongozi wa Moabu, mtetemeko uliwakamata; wote wakaao Kanaani waliyeyuka.
sw.B: Ndipo wakuu wa koo za Edomu walishikwa na hofu; watawala wa Moabu walikamatwa na kutetemeka; wote waliokaa Kanaani walikufa moyo.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Edomu waliogopa sana. Watawala wa Moabu walitetemeka kwa hofu. Watu wote wa Kanaani walipoteza ujasiri.

ko.L: 그때에 에돔의 족장들이 놀라고, 모압의 지도자들은 떨림이 그들을 사로잡았으며, 가나안의 모든 주민이 녹아내렸습니다.
ko.B: 그때 에돔의 족장들은 겁에 질리고, 모압의 지도자들은 두려워 떨었으며, 가나안에 사는 사람들은 모두 간담이 녹았습니다.
ko.R: 에돔의 지도자들은 두려워했습니다. 모압의 지도자들은 무서워 떨었습니다. 가나안 사람들은 모두 용기를 잃었습니다.

decisions.choice: chiefs ... leaders: clan chiefs of Edom, the rulers of Moab
decisions.reason: The word for Edom's chiefs is used of the heads of Esau's clans (Genesis 36:15-19). The word for Moab's leaders means rams, a picture of strong leaders.

decisions.choice: melted away: lost all courage
decisions.reason: Hearts that melt are hearts that lose courage (Joshua 2:9, 11; 5:1).

decisions.choice: Edom, Moab, Canaan: the peoples on Israel's way to the promised land
decisions.reason: Edom and Moab lay south and east of the Dead Sea, and Israel passed by them (Numbers 20-21). Canaan is the land promised to the fathers (6:4).

decisions.choice: lost heart (Balanced); lost their courage (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "melted away" means.

source.text: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֨תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Falls on them terror and dread; by [the] greatness of your arm they are still like stone, until passes over your people, O Yahweh, until passes over [the] people which you acquired.

en.L: Terror and dread fell on them; by the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm they became still as stone, until {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people passed over, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, until the people that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} acquired passed over.
en.B: Fear and dread came down on them; at the might of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm they stood silent as stone, while {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people crossed over, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, while the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own crossed over.
en.R: Terror and fear fell on them. Your great power made them as still as a rock until {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people passed by, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}. They stood still until the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own had passed by.

es.L: Cayeron sobre ellos el terror y el espanto; por la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo se quedaron quietos como piedra, hasta que pasó {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, oh {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hasta que pasó el pueblo que adquiriste.
es.B: El miedo y el pavor descendieron sobre ellos; ante el poder de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo se quedaron inmóviles como piedras, mientras {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo cruzaba, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, mientras cruzaba el pueblo que hiciste {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}.
es.R: El terror y el miedo cayeron sobre ellos. Tu gran poder los dejó quietos como una roca hasta que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo pasó, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Se quedaron quietos hasta que pasó el pueblo que habías hecho {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}.

fr.L: L’effroi et la crainte sont tombés sur eux ; devant la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras, ils se sont figés comme la pierre, jusqu’à ce que passe {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, ô {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à ce que passe le peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as acquis.
fr.B: La peur et l’effroi se sont abattus sur eux ; devant la force de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras, ils sont restés figés comme des pierres, pendant que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple traversait, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pendant que traversait le peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as pris pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: La terreur et la peur sont tombées sur eux. Ta grande puissance les a rendus immobiles comme un rocher, jusqu’à ce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple soit passé, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils sont restés immobiles jusqu’à ce que le peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais pris pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} soit passé.

sw.L: Kitisho na hofu kuu viliwaangukia; kwa ukuu wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wakawa kimya kama jiwe, mpaka watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipovuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mpaka walipovuka watu uliojipatia.
sw.B: Woga na hofu kuu viliwashukia; mbele ya uweza wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walisimama kimya kama mawe, watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokuwa wakivuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu uliowafanya kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokuwa wakivuka.
sw.R: Hofu na woga viliwaangukia. Uwezo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mkuu uliwafanya watulie kama mwamba mpaka watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipopita, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walikaa kimya mpaka watu uliowafanya kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokwisha kupita.

ko.L: 공포와 두려움이 그들에게 떨어졌고, 주님의 팔의 크심으로 그들이 돌처럼 잠잠하였습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성이 지나갈 때까지, 주님께서 얻으신 백성이 지나갈 때까지 그러하였습니다.
ko.B: 공포와 두려움이 그들을 덮쳤고, 주님의 강한 팔 때문에 그들은 돌처럼 굳어 말이 없었습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성이 다 건너갈 때까지, 주님께서 주님의 것으로 삼으신 백성이 다 건너갈 때까지 그러하였습니다.
ko.R: 두려움과 무서움이 그들에게 닥쳤습니다. 주님의 크신 능력 때문에 그들은 바위처럼 꼼짝하지 못했습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성이 지나갈 때까지 그들은 가만히 서 있었습니다. 주님께서 주님의 것으로 삼으신 백성이 다 지나갈 때까지 그러했습니다.

decisions.choice: the greatness of your arm: your great power
decisions.reason: The arm stands for strength. God promised to redeem Israel "with an outstretched arm" (6:6).

decisions.choice: passed over: crossed over, passed by
decisions.reason: The verb may mean passing through the lands of these peoples or crossing over the Jordan into Canaan (Joshua 3-4). The nations stand frozen with fear and do not stop them.

decisions.choice: acquired: gained as your own
decisions.reason: The verb means to get or acquire, often by buying. God has made Israel his own people (6:7; 19:5). The verb is also used of God as maker (Genesis 14:19, 22; Deuteronomy 32:6).

decisions.choice: made your own
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "acquired" here: Israel belongs to God.

source.text: תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֨מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כּוֹנְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You will bring them and you will plant them on [the] mountain of your inheritance, [the] place for you to dwell [which] you have made, O Yahweh, [the] sanctuary, O my Lord, [which] have established your hands.

en.L: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance, [the] place for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to dwell [that] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [the] sanctuary, O Lord, [that] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have established.
en.B: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance, the place {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have prepared for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling, O {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the sanctuary, O Lord, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands set firm.
en.R: You will bring {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people in and plant them on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own mountain. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that is the place {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} home. Lord, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands built that holy place.

es.L: Los harás entrar y los plantarás en el monte de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} herencia, [el] lugar para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} habites [que] has hecho, oh {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [el] santuario, oh Señor, [que] establecieron {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos.
es.B: Los harás entrar y los plantarás en el monte que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} herencia, el lugar que preparaste para habitar, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el santuario, Señor, que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos asentaron con firmeza.
es.R: Harás entrar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo y lo plantarás en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio monte. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ese es el lugar que hiciste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} hogar. Señor, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos construyeron ese lugar santo.

fr.L: Tu les feras entrer et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les planteras sur la montagne de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage, [le] lieu pour y habiter [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es fait, ô {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [le] sanctuaire, ô Seigneur, [que] {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains ont affermi.
fr.B: Tu les feras entrer et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les planteras sur la montagne qui est {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage, le lieu que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as préparé pour y habiter, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le sanctuaire, Seigneur, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains ont solidement établi.
fr.R: Tu feras entrer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le planteras sur {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} propre montagne. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est l’endroit dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison. Seigneur, ce lieu saint, ce sont {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains qui l’ont construit.

sw.L: Utawaleta ndani na kuwapanda juu ya mlima wa urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mahali pa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kukaa [ambapo] umepafanya, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mahali patakatifu, Ee Bwana, [ambapo] mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imepasimika.
sw.B: Utawaleta ndani na kuwapanda juu ya mlima ulio urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mahali ulipoandaa pawe makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mahali patakatifu, Ee Bwana, ambapo mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yenyewe ilipasimika imara.
sw.R: Utawaleta watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ndani na kuwapanda juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwenyewe. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hapo ndipo mahali ulipopafanya kuwa nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. Bwana, mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yenyewe ndiyo iliyojenga mahali hapo patakatifu.

ko.L: 주님께서 그들을 데리고 들어가셔서 주님의 기업의 산에 심으실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그곳은 주님께서 거하시려고 만드신 곳, 주님, 주님의 손으로 세우신 성소입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그들을 데리고 들어가셔서 주님의 소유인 산에 심으실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그곳은 주님께서 머무시려고 마련하신 곳입니다. 주님, 그곳은 주님의 손으로 굳게 세우신 성소입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 주님의 백성을 데리고 들어가셔서 주님의 산에 심으실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그곳은 주님께서 머무시려고 마련하신 곳입니다. 주님, 그 거룩한 곳은 주님께서 손수 지으신 곳입니다.

decisions.choice: plant them: settle them for good
decisions.reason: God's people are pictured as a tree planted to stay (2 Samuel 7:10; Psalm 80:9).

decisions.choice: the mountain of your inheritance: the land and the mountain that belong to God
decisions.reason: "Inheritance" is what is one's own to keep. The mountain may mean the hill country of Canaan as a whole (Deuteronomy 3:25; Psalm 78:54) or the mountain where God's sanctuary would stand, later Zion.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary, O Lord: the holy place God founds for himself
decisions.reason: The word means a holy place, the word used of the tabernacle in 25:8. "Lord" here is the title meaning master, not the divine name. God himself, not human builders, establishes it.

decisions.choice: your people
decisions.reason: Readable names whom God will bring in.

decisions.choice: "주님" for Adonai, beside the divine-name vocative "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis sheet sets, Adonai is "주님"; the two names stay distinct, as in the Hebrew. "성소" is the term sheet's word for the sanctuary.

source.text: יְהוָ֥ה׀יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will reign forever and ever."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will reign forever and ever!"
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rule as king forever and ever!"

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reinará por siempre y para siempre».
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reinará para siempre jamás!».
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será rey por siempre y para siempre!».

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} régnera pour toujours et à jamais. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} régnera à perpétuité, pour toujours ! »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera roi pour toujours et à jamais ! »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatawala daima na milele."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatawala milele hata milele!"
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mfalme milele na milele!"

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 영원무궁토록 다스리실 것이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 영원무궁토록 다스리실 것이다!"
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이 되셔서 영원히 다스리실 것이다!"

decisions.choice: will reign: will be king
decisions.reason: This is the first time the Bible says Yahweh reigns as king. Pharaoh's power is broken; Yahweh's rule has no end.

decisions.choice: forever and ever: for all time
decisions.reason: Two words for unending time are joined for force (Psalm 10:16).

decisions.choice: rule as king
decisions.reason: Readable spells out "reign".

source.text: כִּ֣י בָא֩ ס֨וּס פַּרְעֹ֜ה בְּרִכְבּ֤וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֙ בַּיָּ֔ם וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For went [the] horse[s] of Pharaoh with his chariot[s] and with his horsemen into the sea, and brought back Yahweh on them the waters of the sea, and [the] sons of Israel walked on dry ground in [the] midst of the sea.

en.L: For the horses of Pharaoh went with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought back the waters of the sea upon them, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel walked on dry ground in the midst of the sea.
en.B: Pharaoh's horses, with his chariots and his horsemen, had gone into the sea, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had turned the sea's waters back on top of them; but the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground.
en.R: This is what happened: Pharaoh's horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the water flow back over them. But the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had walked across the sea on dry ground.

es.L: Porque los caballos del faraón entraron con sus carros y con sus jinetes en el mar, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo volver sobre ellos las aguas del mar, y los hijos de Israel anduvieron sobre tierra seca en medio del mar.
es.B: Los caballos del faraón, con sus carros y sus jinetes, habían entrado en el mar, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho que las aguas del mar se les vinieran encima; pero los israelitas habían cruzado por en medio del mar sobre tierra seca.
es.R: Esto fue lo que pasó: los caballos, los carros y los jinetes del faraón entraron en el mar, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que el agua volviera y los cubriera. Pero los israelitas habían cruzado el mar caminando sobre tierra seca.

fr.L: Car les chevaux de Pharaon, avec ses chars et avec ses cavaliers, entrèrent dans la mer, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ramena sur eux les eaux de la mer ; et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël marchèrent sur la terre sèche au milieu de la mer.
fr.B: Les chevaux de Pharaon, avec ses chars et ses cavaliers, étaient entrés dans la mer, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait retomber sur eux les eaux de la mer ; mais les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient traversé la mer en marchant sur la terre sèche.
fr.R: Voici ce qui s’était passé : les chevaux, les chars et les cavaliers de Pharaon sont entrés dans la mer, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait revenir l’eau sur eux. Mais les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient traversé la mer à pied, sur la terre sèche.

sw.L: Kwa maana farasi wa Farao waliingia baharini pamoja na magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akayarudisha maji ya bahari juu yao; na wana wa Israeli walitembea juu ya ardhi kavu katikati ya bahari.
sw.B: Farasi wa Farao, pamoja na magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake, walikuwa wameingia baharini, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameyarejesha maji ya bahari juu yao; lakini Waisraeli walikuwa wamevuka katikati ya bahari juu ya ardhi kavu.
sw.R: Haya ndiyo yaliyotokea: farasi wa Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake waliingia baharini, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akayafanya maji yarudi juu yao. Lakini Waisraeli walikuwa wamevuka bahari wakitembea juu ya ardhi kavu.

ko.L: 바로의 말들이 그의 병거와 그의 기병과 함께 바다에 들어갔을 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바닷물을 그들 위로 되돌리셨고, 이스라엘 자손은 바다 한가운데로 마른 땅 위를 걸어갔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 바로의 말들이 병거와 기병과 함께 바다로 들어갔을 때, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바닷물을 그들 위로 되돌려 덮으셨다. 그러나 이스라엘 백성은 마른 땅을 밟고 바다 한가운데를 지나갔다.
ko.R: 이런 일이 있었다. 바로의 말과 병거와 기병이 바다로 들어갔을 때, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 물이 다시 그들 위로 흘러가게 하셨다. 그러나 이스라엘 사람들은 마른 땅을 밟고 바다를 건너갔다.

decisions.choice: for: this happened when ... a summary of the crossing
decisions.reason: The verse sums up 14:23-29 in prose after the song. It may give the reason for the song or set the scene for Miriam's singing.

decisions.choice: horse: Pharaoh's horses
decisions.reason: The singular stands for all of Pharaoh's horses, as in 14:9, 23.

decisions.choice: had gone ... had turned ... had walked (Balanced); This is what happened (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the verse as looking back. Readable opens with a phrase that shows it is a summary.

source.text: וַתִּקַּח֩ מִרְיָ֨ם הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֲח֧וֹת אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־הַתֹּ֖ף בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַתֵּצֶ֤אןָ כָֽל־הַנָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יהָ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Miriam the prophetess, [the] sister of Aaron, the tambourine in her hand, and went out all the women after her with tambourines and with dances.

en.L: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the tambourine in her hand, and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
en.B: Miriam the prophetess, Aaron's sister, picked up a tambourine, and all the women came out behind her, beating tambourines and dancing.
en.R: Aaron's sister Miriam was a prophet. She took a tambourine in her hand. All the women followed her, playing tambourines and dancing.

es.L: Y Miriam la profetisa, la hermana de Aarón, tomó en su mano la pandereta, y todas las mujeres salieron detrás de ella con panderetas y con danzas.
es.B: Miriam la profetisa, hermana de Aarón, tomó una pandereta, y todas las mujeres salieron detrás de ella tocando panderetas y bailando.
es.R: Miriam, la hermana de Aarón, era profeta. Tomó una pandereta en la mano, y todas las mujeres la siguieron tocando panderetas y bailando.

fr.L: Et Myriam la prophétesse, la sœur d’Aaron, prit le tambourin dans sa main, et toutes les femmes sortirent derrière elle avec des tambourins et avec des danses.
fr.B: Myriam la prophétesse, sœur d’Aaron, prit un tambourin, et toutes les femmes sortirent derrière elle en frappant des tambourins et en dansant.
fr.R: Myriam, la sœur d’Aaron, était prophète. Elle a pris un tambourin dans sa main. Toutes les femmes l’ont suivie en jouant du tambourin et en dansant.

sw.L: Na Miriamu nabii mke, dada yake Haruni, alichukua tari mkononi mwake, na wanawake wote wakatoka nyuma yake wakiwa na matari na wakicheza.
sw.B: Miriamu nabii wa kike, dada yake Haruni, alichukua tari, na wanawake wote wakatoka nyuma yake wakipiga matari na kucheza.
sw.R: Miriamu, dada yake Haruni, alikuwa nabii. Alichukua tari mkononi mwake. Wanawake wote wakamfuata wakipiga matari na kucheza.

ko.L: 그리고 아론의 누이 예언자 미리암이 손에 소고를 잡으니, 모든 여인이 소고를 들고 춤을 추며 그를 따라 나왔다.
ko.B: 아론의 누이인 예언자 미리암이 소고를 손에 드니, 모든 여인이 그를 따라 나와 소고를 치며 춤을 추었다.
ko.R: 아론의 누이 미리암은 예언자였다. 미리암이 손에 소고를 들었다. 모든 여자가 그를 따라 나와 소고를 치며 춤을 추었다.

decisions.choice: Miriam the prophetess: a woman who spoke for God
decisions.reason: Miriam is the first woman the Bible calls a prophet. Later Deborah and Huldah are called prophetesses (Judges 4:4; 2 Kings 22:14). God spoke through Miriam as well as Moses (Numbers 12:2; Micah 6:4).

decisions.choice: the sister of Aaron: and of Moses
decisions.reason: Miriam was the sister of Aaron and Moses (Numbers 26:59), most likely the sister who watched over the baby Moses (2:4, 7). She is named here with Aaron, perhaps because he was the elder brother.

decisions.choice: tambourines and dances: the women's victory celebration
decisions.reason: The instrument was a hand drum, a frame drum beaten by hand. Women went out with drums and dancing to welcome a victory (Judges 11:34; 1 Samuel 18:6).

decisions.choice: prophet
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer word "prophet" for a woman as for a man; Literal and Balanced say "prophetess".

decisions.choice: "예언자" for the prophetess; "소고" for the tambourine
decisions.reason: Korean "예언자" is used for women and men alike (the style guide prefers it to 선지자); "소고" is the Korean hand drum the Korean Psalms use for this instrument.

source.text: וַתַּ֥עַן לָהֶ֖ם מִרְיָ֑ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And answered them Miriam, sing to Yahweh, for highly he is exalted; horse and its rider he has thrown in [the] sea.

en.L: And Miriam answered them, "Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for highly exalted is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; horse and its rider {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cast into the sea."
en.B: Miriam led them in the refrain: "Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is lifted high in triumph; horse and rider {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has flung into the sea."
en.R: Miriam led them in singing: "Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won a great victory. He threw the horses and their riders into the sea."

es.L: Y Miriam les respondió: «{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque altamente se ha exaltado; al caballo y a su jinete los ha lanzado al mar».
es.B: Miriam los guio en el estribillo: «{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque se ha alzado triunfante; a caballo y jinete los ha arrojado al mar».
es.R: Miriam los guio en el canto: «{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado una gran victoria. Tiró al mar a los caballos y a sus jinetes».

fr.L: Et Myriam leur répondit : « Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est hautement élevé ; le cheval et son cavalier, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a jetés dans la mer. »
fr.B: Myriam les entraîna dans le refrain : « Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est élevé en triomphe ; cheval et cavalier, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a précipités dans la mer. »
fr.R: Myriam a dirigé le chant : « Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a remporté une grande victoire. Il a jeté dans la mer les chevaux et leurs cavaliers. »

sw.L: Na Miriamu aliwajibu, "Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ameinuka juu kabisa; farasi na mpandaji wake amewatupa baharini."
sw.B: Miriamu aliwaongoza katika kiitikio: "Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ameinuka juu kwa ushindi; farasi na mpandaji amewavurumisha baharini."
sw.R: Miriamu aliwaongoza kuimba: "Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu amepata ushindi mkubwa. Amewatupa baharini farasi na wapanda farasi wao."

ko.L: 그리고 미리암이 그들에게 화답하였다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 그분께서 높이 높이 오르셨다. 말과 그 탄 자를 그분께서 바다에 던지셨다."
ko.B: 미리암이 그들의 노래에 화답하여 불렀다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 그분께서 크게 이기시고 높임을 받으셨다. 말과 기병을 그분께서 바다에 내던지셨다."
ko.R: 미리암이 앞장서서 노래를 불렀다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 그분께서 크게 이기셨다. 그분께서 말과 말 탄 군사들을 바다에 던져 버리셨다."

decisions.choice: answered them: sang back to them, led them in response
decisions.reason: The verb means to answer, and in song to sing in response. Miriam and the women sing back, perhaps after each part of the song or as its refrain. "Them" is masculine, which may mean the whole people.

decisions.choice: the refrain of verse 1
decisions.reason: Miriam's words repeat the opening of the song (verse 1), with "Sing" in place of "I will sing".

decisions.choice: led them in the refrain (Balanced); led them in singing (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "answered" means here. Literal keeps "answered".

source.text: וַיַּסַּ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּם־ס֔וּף וַיֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל־מִדְבַּר־שׁ֑וּר וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת־יָמִ֛ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְלֹא־מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And led out Moses Israel from [the] Sea of Reeds, and they went out into [the] wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness and not they found water.

en.L: And Moses led Israel out from the Sea of Reeds, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness and did not find water.
en.B: Moses had Israel move on from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur. For three days they walked through the wilderness without coming upon any water.
en.R: Then Moses led the Israelites away from the Red Sea into the Shur Desert. They walked for three days in the desert, and they did not find any water.

es.L: Y Moisés sacó a Israel del mar de los Juncos, y se dirigieron al desierto de Shur; y caminaron tres días en el desierto y no encontraron agua.
es.B: Moisés hizo que Israel levantara el campamento y dejara el mar Rojo, y entraron en el desierto de Shur. Durante tres días caminaron por el desierto sin dar con agua.
es.R: Después Moisés llevó a los israelitas lejos del mar Rojo, al desierto de Shur. Caminaron tres días por el desierto y no encontraron agua.

fr.L: Et Moïse fit partir Israël de la mer des Joncs, et ils sortirent vers le désert de Shour ; et ils marchèrent trois jours dans le désert et ne trouvèrent pas d’eau.
fr.B: Moïse fit lever le camp à Israël, loin de la mer Rouge, et ils s’avancèrent dans le désert de Shour. Pendant trois jours, ils marchèrent dans le désert sans trouver d’eau.
fr.R: Ensuite Moïse a conduit les Israélites loin de la mer Rouge, dans le désert de Shour. Ils ont marché pendant trois jours dans le désert et n’ont pas trouvé d’eau.

sw.L: Na Musa aliwaondoa Israeli kutoka Bahari ya Matete, nao wakatoka kuingia nyika ya Shuri; wakatembea siku tatu nyikani, wala hawakupata maji.
sw.B: Musa aliwafanya Waisraeli wangoe kambi kutoka Bahari ya Shamu, nao wakaingia nyika ya Shuri. Kwa siku tatu walitembea nyikani bila kukuta maji.
sw.R: Kisha Musa aliwaongoza Waisraeli mbali na Bahari ya Shamu, wakaingia jangwa la Shuri. Walitembea jangwani kwa siku tatu, lakini hawakupata maji.

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 이스라엘을 갈대 바다에서 이끌어 내니, 그들이 수르 광야로 나갔다. 그들이 사흘 동안 광야를 걸었으나 물을 찾지 못하였다.
ko.B: 모세는 이스라엘을 홍해에서 떠나게 하였고, 그들은 수르 광야로 들어갔다. 그들은 사흘 동안 광야를 걸었지만 물을 하나도 찾지 못하였다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 모세는 이스라엘 사람들을 이끌고 홍해를 떠나 수르 광야로 들어갔다. 그들은 사흘 동안 광야를 걸었지만 물을 찾지 못했다.

decisions.choice: led out: had the people set out, break camp
decisions.reason: The verb is used of pulling up tent pegs and setting out on a journey (12:37; 13:20).

decisions.choice: the wilderness of Shur: the desert east of Egypt
decisions.reason: Shur lay on the eastern border of Egypt, on the way from Egypt toward Canaan (Genesis 16:7; 25:18; 1 Samuel 15:7).

decisions.choice: three days: the journey Moses had asked Pharaoh for
decisions.reason: Moses had asked to go "three days' journey" into the wilderness to sacrifice (3:18; 5:3). After three days the people find no water.

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: As at 10:19 and 15:4. Literal says "Sea of Reeds".

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָה וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֨יִם֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י מָרִ֖ים הֵ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמָ֖הּ מָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came to Marah, and not they were able to drink water from Marah, for bitter [were] they; therefore one called its name Marah.

en.L: And they came to Marah, and they could not drink [the] water from Marah, for it [was] bitter; therefore its name was called Marah.
en.B: When they came to Marah, they could not drink the water there, because it was bitter. That is why the place was named Marah.
en.R: They came to a place called Marah. They could not drink the water there because it was bitter. That is why the place is called Marah, which means "bitter."

es.L: Y llegaron a Mara, pero no podían beber el agua de Mara, pues [era] amarga; por eso se llamó su nombre Mara.
es.B: Cuando llegaron a Mara, no pudieron beber el agua de allí, porque era amarga. Por eso el lugar recibió el nombre de Mara.
es.R: Llegaron a un lugar llamado Mara. No podían beber el agua porque era amarga. Por eso ese lugar se llama Mara, que quiere decir «amarga».

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent à Mara, et ils ne pouvaient pas boire l’eau de Mara, car elle [était] amère ; c’est pourquoi on appela son nom Mara.
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à Mara, ils ne purent pas en boire l’eau, car elle était amère. Voilà pourquoi on donna à cet endroit le nom de Mara.
fr.R: Ils sont arrivés à un endroit appelé Mara. Ils ne pouvaient pas boire l’eau, parce qu’elle était amère. C’est pour cela que cet endroit s’appelle Mara, ce qui veut dire « amère ».

sw.L: Walifika Mara, lakini hawakuweza kunywa maji ya Mara, kwa sababu [yalikuwa] machungu; kwa hiyo paliitwa jina Mara.
sw.B: Walipofika Mara, hawakuweza kuyanywa maji ya pale kwa sababu yalikuwa machungu. Ndiyo sababu mahali hapo paliitwa Mara.
sw.R: Walifika mahali palipoitwa Mara. Hawakuweza kunywa maji ya pale kwa sababu yalikuwa machungu. Ndiyo maana mahali hapo panaitwa Mara, maana yake "uchungu."
