ko.L: 그리고 그들이 마라에 이르렀으나 마라의 물을 마실 수 없었다. 그것이 썼기 때문이다. 그래서 그곳의 이름을 마라라고 하였다.
ko.B: 그들이 마라에 이르렀는데, 그곳 물이 써서 마실 수가 없었다. 그래서 그곳 이름을 마라라고 하였다.
ko.R: 그들은 마라라는 곳에 이르렀다. 그러나 그곳 물은 써서 마실 수가 없었다. 그래서 그곳을 "쓰다"라는 뜻으로 마라라고 부른다.

decisions.choice: Marah: "bitter"
decisions.reason: The name Marah means bitter, and is from the same root as "bitter" in this verse. Naomi takes the name Mara for her bitter grief (Ruth 1:20).

decisions.choice: one called its name: it was named
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject: people called it so.

decisions.choice: which means "bitter"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name, which makes the point of the verse.

decisions.choice: "\"쓰다\"라는 뜻으로" at Readable
decisions.reason: The name means "bitter" (meaning decision, footnoted); Readable explains the wordplay as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיִּלֹּ֧נוּ הָעָ֛ם עַל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר מַה־נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And grumbled the people against Moses, saying, what will we drink?

en.L: And the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What will we drink?"
en.B: The people grumbled at Moses. "What are we going to drink?" they said.
en.R: The people grumbled to Moses. "What will we drink?" they asked.

es.L: Y el pueblo murmuró contra Moisés, diciendo: «¿Qué beberemos?».
es.B: El pueblo se quejó contra Moisés. «¿Qué vamos a beber?», decían.
es.R: La gente se quejó con Moisés. «¿Qué vamos a beber?», le preguntaban.

fr.L: Et le peuple murmura contre Moïse, disant : « Qu’allons-nous boire ? »
fr.B: Le peuple récrimina contre Moïse : « Qu’est-ce que nous allons boire ? » disaient-ils.
fr.R: Le peuple s’est plaint à Moïse. « Qu’est-ce qu’on va boire ? » ont-ils demandé.

sw.L: Na watu walimnung'unikia Musa, wakisema, "Tutakunywa nini?"
sw.B: Watu walimlalamikia Musa. "Tutakunywa nini sasa?" walisema.
sw.R: Watu walimnung'unikia Musa. Wakauliza, "Tutakunywa nini?"

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 모세에게 불평하며 말하였다. "우리가 무엇을 마시겠습니까?"
ko.B: 백성은 모세에게 "우리가 무엇을 마셔야 합니까?" 하고 불평하였다.
ko.R: 백성은 모세에게 "우리는 무엇을 마십니까?" 하고 불평했다.

decisions.choice: grumbled: complained, murmured in discontent
decisions.reason: The verb means to complain against someone. This is the first of Israel's complaints in the wilderness (16:2, 7-8; 17:3; Numbers 14:2), against Moses and so against God (16:8).

decisions.choice: What will we drink?: three days after the sea
decisions.reason: The people who sang of God's power three days before now ask what they will drink. Their question is a complaint, not a request.

decisions.choice: "불평하다" for lun, to grumble
decisions.reason: "원망하다" is the familiar church word but now means to resent someone; "불평하다" is the everyday word for grumbling, the sense the meaning decision gives. This holds for these chapters.

source.text: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־יְהוָ֗ה וַיּוֹרֵ֤הוּ יְהוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־הַמַּ֔יִם וַֽיִּמְתְּק֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְשָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he cried out to Yahweh, and showed him Yahweh a tree, and he threw [it] into the waters, and became sweet the waters. There he made for him a statute and a rule, and there he tested him.

en.L: And he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} showed him a tree, and he threw [it] into the water, and the water became sweet. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made for them a statute and a rule, and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tested them.
en.B: Moses cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pointed him to a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water turned sweet. It was there that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} laid down a statute and a rule for them, and there that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put them to the test.
en.R: Moses cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} showed him a piece of wood. Moses threw it into the water, and the water became good to drink. There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave the people a rule and a law to live by. And there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tested them.

es.L: Y él clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le enseñó un árbol; y [lo] arrojó al agua, y el agua se volvió dulce. Allí {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les fijó un estatuto y una norma, y allí los sometió a prueba.
es.B: Moisés clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le indicó un trozo de madera. Lo arrojó al agua, y el agua se volvió dulce. Fue allí donde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les impuso un estatuto y una norma, y allí los puso a prueba.
es.R: Moisés le pidió ayuda a gritos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le mostró un pedazo de madera. Moisés lo tiró al agua, y el agua se volvió buena para beber. Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio al pueblo una norma y una ley para vivir. Y allí los puso a prueba.

fr.L: Et il cria vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui montra un arbre ; et il [le] jeta dans l’eau, et l’eau devint douce. Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur fixa une prescription et une règle, et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les mit à l’épreuve.
fr.B: Moïse cria vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui désigna un morceau de bois. Il le lança dans l’eau, et l’eau devint douce. C’est là que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} établit pour eux une prescription et une règle, et là qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les mit à l’épreuve.
fr.R: Moïse a appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a montré un morceau de bois. Moïse l’a jeté dans l’eau, et l’eau est devenue bonne à boire. Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné au peuple une règle et une loi pour vivre. Et là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a mis à l’épreuve.

sw.L: Naye alimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwonyesha mti; naye akautupa majini, na maji yakageuka matamu. Pale aliwawekea kanuni na agizo, na pale akawajaribu.
sw.B: Musa alimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwonyesha kipande cha mti. Akakitupa majini, na maji yakawa matamu. Hapo ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowawekea kanuni na agizo, na hapo ndipo alipowajaribu.
sw.R: Musa alimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsaidie, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwonyesha kipande cha mti. Musa akakitupa majini, na maji yakawa mazuri ya kunywa. Hapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa watu kanuni na sheria za kuishi nazo. Tena hapo aliwajaribu.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 나무 한 그루를 보여 주셨다. 그가 [그것을] 물에 던지자 물이 달게 되었다. 거기서 그분께서 그들에게 규례와 법도를 정해 주셨고, 거기서 그들을 시험하셨다.
ko.B: 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 나무 한 토막을 가리켜 보이셨다. 모세가 그것을 물에 던지니 물이 단물로 바뀌었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그곳에서 그들에게 규례와 법도를 세워 주시고, 그곳에서 그들을 시험하셨다.
ko.R: 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖었다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 나무 한 토막을 보여 주셨다. 모세가 그것을 물에 던지자 물이 마실 수 있는 물로 바뀌었다. 그곳에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 백성에게 지키며 살아갈 규례와 법도를 주셨다. 그리고 그곳에서 그들을 시험하셨다.

decisions.choice: showed him a tree: pointed out, taught him about a piece of wood
decisions.reason: The word means a tree or a piece of wood. The verb "showed" is the verb for teaching or instructing: God taught Moses what to do. The healing came from God, not from the wood.

decisions.choice: there he made for them a statute and a rule: God, for Israel
alternatives: there Moses made for them a statute and a rule
decisions.reason: "He" is most likely Yahweh, who speaks in verse 26 and who tests Israel again in 16:4. The pronoun "him" is singular in Hebrew; it means the people as one body.

decisions.choice: tested them: proved them, to show what was in their hearts
decisions.reason: God tests his people to show whether they will trust and obey him (16:4; 20:20; Deuteronomy 8:2). The test is the condition in verse 26.

decisions.choice: Moses ... the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who cries out and who makes the statute; the Hebrew says only "he". Literal keeps "he".

decisions.choice: a rule and a law to live by
decisions.reason: Readable says "rule" for "statute", as elsewhere in Exodus, and "law" for the second word.

decisions.choice: "규례와 법도" for choq and mishpat
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch term sheet sets ("규례" for a statute, "법도" for a rule). This holds for these chapters.

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְק֣וֹל׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֺתָ֔יו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־חֻקָּ֑יו כָּֽל־הַמַּֽחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְמִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹא־אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said, if surely you listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God, and the right in his eyes you do, and you give ear to his commandments and you keep all his statutes, any of the sickness which I put on Egypt not will I put on you, for I [am] Yahweh [who] heals you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "If you will surely listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and do what is right in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes, and give ear to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, and keep all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, none of the sicknesses that I put on Egypt will I put on you, for I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [who] heals you."
en.B: He said, "If you listen closely to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees as right, if you pay heed to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands and keep all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, I will spare you every one of the sicknesses that I laid on the Egyptians. For I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who heals you."
en.R: He said, "Listen carefully to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says is right. Pay attention to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands, and obey all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rules. If you do, I will not make you suffer any of the diseases I sent on the Egyptians. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who heals you."

es.L: Y dijo: «Si escuchas atentamente la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, y haces lo recto a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, y prestas oído a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, y guardas todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, ninguna de las enfermedades que puse sobre Egipto pondré sobre ti, porque yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que te sana».
es.B: Dijo: «Si escuchas con atención la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y haces lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} considera justo, si atiendes a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos y cumples todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, te libraré de todas las enfermedades que mandé sobre los egipcios. Porque yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que te sana».
es.R: Dijo: «Escucha bien {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y haz lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice que es correcto. Presta atención a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, y obedece todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas. Si lo haces, no te haré sufrir ninguna de las enfermedades que mandé a los egipcios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el que te sana».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Si tu écoutes, si tu écoutes vraiment la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et si tu fais ce qui est juste à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, et si tu tends l’oreille vers {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, et si tu gardes toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, aucune des maladies que j’ai mises sur l’Égypte, je ne la mettrai sur toi, car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [je suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui te guérit. »
fr.B: Il dit : « Si vraiment tu écoutes la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et fais ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} considère comme juste, si tu es attentif à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements et respectes toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, je t’épargnerai toutes les maladies que j’ai infligées aux Égyptiens. Car je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui te guérit. »
fr.R: Il a dit : « Écoute bien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et fais ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} appelle juste. Sois attentif à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, et obéis à toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles. Si tu le fais, je ne te ferai souffrir d’aucune des maladies que j’ai envoyées aux Égyptiens. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui te guérit. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Ukiisikiliza kwa makini sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na kufanya yaliyo sawa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, na kuzitegea sikio amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, na kuzishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote, magonjwa yote niliyoyaweka juu ya Misri, sitakuwekea hata mmoja, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ninayekuponya."
sw.B: Alisema, "Ukisikiliza kwa makini sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kufanya yale anayoyaona kuwa sawa, ukizitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kushika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote, nitakuepusha na kila mojawapo ya magonjwa niliyowaletea Wamisri. Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ninayekuponya."
sw.R: Alisema, "Msikilize kwa makini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na ufanye yale anayosema ni sawa. Zitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, na ushike kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote. Ukifanya hivyo, sitakuletea hata ugonjwa mmoja kati ya yale niliyowaletea Wamisri. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninayekuponya."

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "만일 너희가 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 잘 듣고, 그의 눈에 옳은 일을 하며, 그의 계명에 귀를 기울이고, 그의 모든 규례를 지키면, 내가 이집트에 내린 질병을 하나도 너희에게 내리지 않을 것이다. 나는 너희를 치료하는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "너희가 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 귀담아듣고, 그가 보기에 옳은 일을 하며, 그의 계명에 귀를 기울이고 그의 모든 규례를 지키면, 내가 이집트 사람들에게 내린 질병을 하나도 너희에게 내리지 않겠다. 나는 너희를 고치는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다."
ko.R: 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말을 잘 들어라. 그가 옳다고 하는 일을 하여라. 그의 계명에 귀를 기울이고 그의 모든 규례를 지켜라. 그러면 내가 이집트 사람들에게 내린 병을 하나도 너희에게 내리지 않겠다. 나는 너희를 고쳐 주는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다."

decisions.choice: if you will surely listen: if you listen with care
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for force: real listening that leads to obeying.

decisions.choice: the sicknesses I put on Egypt: the plagues
decisions.reason: God means the plagues, such as the boils (9:8-12). God will not treat obedient Israel as he treated Egypt (Deuteronomy 7:15; 28:27, 60).

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh who heals you: healing is God's work
decisions.reason: God names himself by what he does for Israel. He has just made bitter water sweet; he heals his people. God speaks of himself first by name ("Yahweh your God") and then as "I".

decisions.choice: Listen ... If you do
decisions.reason: Readable turns the long "if" sentence into commands followed by the promise.

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel, so no plural_you span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the people in the singular, as one body, and Spanish keeps the singular; the plural_you setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: "tu" for Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the people in the singular, as one body; French keeps the singular, which French law-giving also uses.

decisions.choice: singular "you" ("ukisikiliza", "Mungu wako") for Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the people in the singular, as one body; Swahili, which marks singular and plural, keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: "그의 눈에", "그의 계명" without the honorific, where God speaks of himself in the third person
decisions.reason: As with God's self-naming (9:5), Korean does not honor oneself; God speaks of "your God Yahweh" and then of "his" commands in the plain style.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָה וְשָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָׁ֖ם עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came to Elim, and there [were] twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; and they camped there by the water.

en.L: And they came to Elim, and there [were] twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; and they camped there by the water.
en.B: Next they arrived at Elim. Twelve springs of water were there, and seventy palm trees, and they set up camp beside the water.
en.R: Next the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came to a place called Elim. It had twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. So they camped there by the water.

es.L: Y llegaron a Elim, y allí [había] doce manantiales de agua y setenta palmeras; y acamparon allí junto al agua.
es.B: Después llegaron a Elim. Allí había doce manantiales y setenta palmeras, y pusieron el campamento a la orilla del agua.
es.R: Luego los israelitas llegaron a un lugar llamado Elim. Tenía doce manantiales de agua y setenta palmeras. Así que acamparon allí, junto al agua.

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent à Élim, et là [il y avait] douze sources d’eau et soixante-dix palmiers ; et ils campèrent là, près de l’eau.
fr.B: Ils parvinrent ensuite à Élim. Il s’y trouvait douze sources et soixante-dix palmiers, et ils dressèrent le camp au bord de l’eau.
fr.R: Ensuite, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont arrivés à un endroit appelé Élim. Il y avait là douze sources d’eau et soixante-dix palmiers. Alors ils ont campé là, près de l’eau.

sw.L: Na walifika Elimu, na huko [kulikuwa na] chemchemi kumi na mbili za maji na mitende sabini; wakapiga kambi huko kando ya maji.
sw.B: Kisha walifika Elimu. Huko kulikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili za maji na mitende sabini, nao wakapiga kambi kando ya maji.
sw.R: Kisha Waisraeli walifika mahali palipoitwa Elimu. Palikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili za maji na mitende sabini. Kwa hiyo walipiga kambi pale karibu na maji.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 엘림에 이르렀는데, 거기에 물샘 열두 개와 종려나무 일흔 그루가 있었다. 그들이 거기 물가에 진을 쳤다.
ko.B: 그다음에 그들은 엘림에 이르렀다. 그곳에는 샘이 열두 개 있고 종려나무가 일흔 그루 있었다. 그들은 그곳 물가에 진을 쳤다.
ko.R: 그다음에 이스라엘 사람들은 엘림이라는 곳에 이르렀다. 그곳에는 샘이 열두 개 있었고, 종려나무가 일흔 그루 있었다. 그래서 그들은 그곳 물가에 진을 쳤다.

decisions.choice: Elim: an oasis with springs and palms
decisions.reason: After the bitter water of Marah, Israel comes to a place with plenty of water and shade. Israel camps at Elim again in Numbers 33:9, which gives the same numbers.

decisions.choice: the Israelites
decisions.reason: Readable names the people who came to Elim.
